# OnDevice

> OnDevice makes free, open-source iPhone apps that run compatible AI models on the device for chat, vision, voice and image generation. Local chat requires no OnDevice account. Optional features can use the network. Token AI (formerly OnDevice Max) and OnDevice Local AI Studio are free on the App Store. OnDevice LAS is a sideload-only build, and OnDevice Image Generation is waiting for App Store release.

Website: https://ondevice.fun/ (English), https://ondevice.fun/tr/ (Turkish), https://ondevice.fun/zh/ (Simplified Chinese)
Source: https://github.com/Mesutcydev/ondevice-core
License: MIT for original code; model weights keep their own licences and are downloaded separately.

## Apps

- Token AI (formerly OnDevice Max; App Store name "Token: Local AI Studio") — status: on the App Store, https://apps.apple.com/app/token-local-ai-studio/id6774354746. iOS 27. The newest all-in-one studio with a new interface: chat, camera Lens (ask, translate, scan, solve), voice conversations, image studio, model library, device status, local API server, paired-Mac tools.
- OnDevice Local AI Studio (App Store name "OnDevice: Local AI Studio") — status: on the App Store, https://apps.apple.com/app/ondevice-local-ai-studio/id6770114399. iOS 18. The original Studio interface: chat, code and snippets, camera Lens with vision models or built-in OCR, voice conversations, local image generation with an optional parental PIN, optional web search, paired-Mac tools and local API.
- OnDevice LAS (On Device: LAS) — status: sideload build only, not on the App Store, 3.2.6 (146), 24.8 MB IPA: https://github.com/Mesutcydev/ios-local-llm/releases/download/sideload-3.2.6-146/OnDeviceLAS-sideload-entitled-3.2.6-146.ipa. iOS 18. Local API server: OpenAI-, Anthropic- and Ollama-compatible routes on one port behind a bearer key.
- OnDevice Image Generation (app name "iOS Image Generation") — status: waiting for App Store release. iOS / iPadOS 26. Stable Diffusion 1.5, 2.1, SDXL, SDXL Turbo and compatible fine-tunes (e.g. RealVisXL, Animagine XL) with MLX and Core ML; image-to-image, model catalog with device-fit checks, private gallery.

## Choosing

- iOS 27 and want the newest interface: Token AI.
- iOS 18 or later, or prefer the original Studio interface: OnDevice Local AI Studio.
- Need an API for Cursor, scripts or agents: the API server inside Token AI, or OnDevice LAS (iOS 18+, sideload only).
- Want to make pictures: OnDevice Image Generation (iOS 26+).

## Availability

- Token AI: App Store, https://apps.apple.com/app/token-local-ai-studio/id6774354746
- OnDevice Local AI Studio: App Store, https://apps.apple.com/app/ondevice-local-ai-studio/id6770114399
- OnDevice LAS: sideload build only, https://github.com/Mesutcydev/ios-local-llm/releases/download/sideload-3.2.6-146/OnDeviceLAS-sideload-entitled-3.2.6-146.ipa (profile-less, ad-hoc signed); re-sign it with AltStore, SideStore or ForgeSign and keep the increased-memory-limit entitlement.
- OnDevice Image Generation: waiting for App Store release.

## Local API (LAS, and the API server in Token AI)

- OpenAI: GET /v1/models, POST /v1/chat/completions, POST /v1/responses (streaming supported)
- Anthropic: POST /v1/messages
- Ollama: model, chat and generate routes under /api
- Default port 11434. Header: Authorization: Bearer <key shown in the app>.
- Plain HTTP for a trusted local network only; do not port-forward. The listener stops when iOS backgrounds the app.

Example:

    curl -N http://PHONE-IP:11434/v1/chat/completions \
      -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
      -d '{"model":"MODEL-ID","stream":true,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Hello"}]}'

## Model families referenced by the apps

Qwen 3, Qwen 3.5, Qwen2.5-Coder, Llama 3.2, Gemma 3, Phi-4, Mistral, Granite, LFM2.5, SmolLM, Edge0 MoE, SmolVLM2, FastVLM, Whisper, Kokoro, Stable Diffusion 1.5 / 2.1, SDXL, SDXL Turbo, RealVisXL, Animagine XL. Availability of a given model depends on device memory.

## Privacy boundaries

- Downloaded local models process prompts on the device. Local chat works without an OnDevice account.
- Model discovery and downloads use the network. Optional web tools, external API providers, iCloud sync and paired Mac features use the network when enabled.
- If a model does not fit in memory the app says so; it never silently falls back to a cloud endpoint.
